summary: Narrow sealed park lane edged by gravel, homes beyond 40 m but open to view.
reasons: Narrow lane, little room to pull off

drivers.seclusion: Playground and oval around; nearest houses about 40-60 m away across the park or road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lane off the road into the park, with a gravel strip on its east edge; tight for a van to clear the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet lane; a busier road at its mouth about 60 m south.
drivers.convention: One car parked by the playground; no campervans seen.

flags: Powerlines and pylons cross the park
Several mapped gates 35-63 m away, each with a way round
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the ring, mainly west and north-west; open sun east and south.
cannot_judge: Gate or bollard closures on the lane

best_section.where: Gravel edge of the sealed lane running into the park, by the trees
